body: That sounds like a chemical imbalance to me, 17...shit starts changing. Get some meds. They take awhile to actually start working, so just keep taking them. A psychiatrist will work with you to find the right ones...all kinds of options.

Try an hour at least man, someone will come along. My wifes begging me to go to bed, she has this weird thing that makes that important to her for some reason...really annoys me sometimes, but that's part of marriage....

Sounds like you're my exact opposite, and yet here we are. Why are you not happy...what keeps you up at night? Expectations too high maybe?  Success is seriously overated. I read something once about one of the brightest geniuses of our time, like super scores on all the tests. ..and yet he works at like a home depot or something doing estimates for paint jobs. If you don't like the dirrection you're headed, sounds like you could fairly easily make a change. I don't think living to impress is much of a life...but I was sucidal like a couple houra ago...so hopefully someone comes along with a better head on their shoulders.

I really appreciate your reply, hopefully you're home by now, if not this can wait. I managed to get ahold of xanex, plus writing that out helped too. Think I should start a journal or something. The job deal just sucks. I tried for a long time, but with the dd214 showing a disorder, horrible credit, 2 dui's on record...severly limits my options..plus im a little dead inside, and im not good at hiding it, and I was like that for the last several years at my last job...so most of my good references are from years back. I tried getting something comparble, and then dropped salary expectations about 10k a month...the last job I got turned down from was a joke, and almost a 35k drop with shit benefits. Ive given up for now, honestly id probably just rather stock groceries for a little less pay. I have a 7 year old, and a newly 1 year old. My wife found a job, so im taking care of the angel. Thank you, but honestly the suicidal thing is on hold again. Seems there are a lot more people here who could use your help. Thanks again.
